messages:
alex_support: FYI incoming escalation from Acme — production bug, structured output failing on function/tool calls. Customer reports our runtime rejects tool args with `invalid_function_args_schema` and they also see intermittent 401s. Pasting trimmed request below.

alex_support: ```
POST /v1/call
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "mode": "json",
  "tool": "charge_customer",
  "arguments": "{\"order_id\":\"ORD-1234\",\"amount\":100}"
}
```

alex_support: Runtime error: `tool-args-parse: invalid JSON at position 1` — looks like arguments is a string, not an object. Customer says SDK was sending `JSON.stringify(args)`.

devon_engineer: thanks — do we have request headers & runtime logs? maybe token refresh race causing 401s separate from parse fail.

devon_engineer: if SDK double-encodes, runtime should either validate or try to coerce. can you paste the exact error block?

alex_support: log dump:

```
[2098765432.112] incoming request id=rid-44 path=/v1/call auth=ok
[2098765432.116] parse-args error id=rid-44 err="invalid JSON at position 1"
[2098765432.117] function-validation id=rid-44 err="schema mismatch: expected object, got string"
[2098765488.002] auth error id=rid-46 err="token expired"\n[2098765488.005] 401 -> client X
```

devon_engineer: got it. which SDK version is customer using?

alex_support: customer says `redwood-js 0.9.1`. They upgraded last week.

maya_sre: we saw a small spike in parse failures after the 0.9.1 rollout yesterday. latency also spiked on warmups which could cause our internal token refresh to collide (hence 401s). suspect two separate issues: SDK change -> double-encoding; and token refresh race under higher p95 latency.

devon_engineer: quick mitigation: runtime patch to attempt JSON.parse if arg is a string AND the declared schema expects an object/array. i'll draft a safe guard that logs a warning and tries reparsing once.

devon_engineer: canary patch + feature flag, then rollback if it breaks.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy of `runtime/parse-coerce-v1` to support cluster at 2026-03-17T18:30Z :rocket:

oliver_product: quick note — we should notify affected customers and add a KB. Also check billing impact: if function calls failed mid-flight, some retries may have been billed. Support, please gather affected customer request ids.

alex_support: collecting request ids now. will update Acme and file a support ticket with logs + workaround: pin SDK to 0.9.0 or update redwood-js patch once available.

devon_engineer: I'll open PR and include tests for tool-arg coercion + a flag `RETRY_PARSE_TOOL_ARGS=true`.

maya_sre: also adding short-term token refresh debounce to reduce 401s during p95 spikes.

alex_support: thanks — action items: (1) devon -> PR + canary, (2) maya -> token debounce, (3) support -> customer comms + request id list. I'll post updates here.

oliver_product: :+1: please CC me on customer comms.
